Yami Gautam Replaces Vidya Balan in Film Story 3

Film producer Sujoy Ghosh has announced that Yami Gautam will replace Vidya Balan as the lead heroine in film Story 3. The decision was made after a meeting between Ghosh and the film's director, which reportedly discussed the script and the actress who would best fit the role. According to sources, Yami Gautam was chosen due to her past success in similar roles and her ability to carry the film on her shoulders. The new story will be different from the previous ones, with a focus on action and adventure. The production team is expected to start filming soon.
